text:
Newsletter DETOX!

Grok @bot got rid of 76 newsletter signups from my inbox. 

I've been avoiding it for years! 

- It went through 6 months of email and found every list I'm on (multiple inboxes)
- Built me one simple HTML: maybe keep vs certainly unsubscribe, with its reasoning
- I skimmed it for 90 seconds
- It's unsubscribing in the browser, tracking in a progress file

Full prompt below 👇
